source.name: Who's in the catalog?
source.instructions: Browse the catalog's **collections / publisher filter**. Which of the following actually publish models in the Azure AI Foundry model catalog? *(Select all that apply.)*
source.guidance: Microsoft, Meta, and Mistral AI all have collections in the catalog (along with OpenAI, Cohere, and others). "Fabrikam" is a fictional company Microsoft uses in documentation examples — you won't find it publishing models!
